name: 11554 · East Meadow, NY
findings: ZIP 11554 (East Meadow) has 109 nonprofit organizations. 41 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 37 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11554 (East Meadow) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 11554 (East Meadow) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 55% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 27 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
